But Docker is a service; you can start it via Docker Desktop or via Docker Engine service. The command "docker start" is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you can use "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service Docker" in PowerShell. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can start the Docker Desktop app.
